game_stop: Natural python-chess automatic termination, including fivefold repetition and 75-move draws; no ply cap accepted as a complete game.
sampling: Five nonterminal positions spread across the completed game, excluding all historical and cross-split translated/reflected board equivalents.
training: No new operational training. One development-only evidence reuse study; final heldout data cannot change hypotheses or thresholds.
calibration: Fit ten-bin Laplace-smoothed strength-to-legality frequency on calibration games; evaluate once on independent heldout opening families. Diagnostic only.
optimization: Investigate redundant immutable model serialization without changing proof payloads or native arithmetic.
temporal: Versioned diagnostic receipt, explicitly separate observed transitions, trusted state metadata and inferred conditions.
native_composition: Review only; no new operator or repeated exhausted probes.
git_policy: Local commits only. No push or external deployment.
